**Finding: missing (medium) — TRANSITION**

Section 11 (Term and Termination) contains term, breach/insolvency termination and a survival clause, but no post-termination transition assistance or data return obligation. The closest language — the mutual "return or destroy any Confidential Information" sentence in Section 11.3 — is not a data export right: it sets no format, no deadline, no machine-readability standard, and lets Commerce One elect destruction. Since Commerce One hosts the MarketSite.net Service that Corio and its Customers access (Section 2.6), our and our Customers' data sits on Commerce One's systems with no defined exit path. The source-code escrow (Section 12) and the surviving run-off/support rights help continuity of the Software but do nothing for data retrieval.

Redline (validated, `ok:true`): new Section 11.4 inserted after 11.3 requiring Commerce One, on expiry or termination for any reason, to (a) provide up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, (b) return all Corio/Customer data in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days, and (c) thereafter delete and certify deletion in writing — with express survival. Fallback of 90 days' assistance flagged in the comment.
